reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first query layer and the shared LinkAccountBaseParams upgradingId; link.ts (findOrCreateBank) offered a natural home but there was no existing duplicate-link check to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule is one helper called from each of the five provider link functions; only the call and the provider literal (already repeated in each function) are repeated.

placement.why: A guard at the start of each link handler in accounts/app.ts is a reasonable layer, though the linking helpers module link.ts would be a slightly more cohesive home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear single query defining 'linked', easy to change; the provider string must be kept in sync by hand with each function's account_sync_source literal.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link paths go through the new guard; no existing abstraction is bypassed.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
